name: East Beach Hotel
accommodation: 32 en-suite rooms including four-poster, executive and suites, some sea-facing or with balconies
suitableFor: Couples, families and dog owners wanting a mid-sized seafront hotel
parking: On-street or public parking only (Visit Eastbourne listing)
beachAccess: On Royal Parade overlooking the sea; Marine Parade beaches about 0.19 miles
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant and bar, breakfast, sea-view lounge and garden, packed lunches, lift, free Wi-Fi, evening entertainment
overview: East Beach Hotel is a Victorian hotel on Royal Parade, on the quieter eastern side of Eastbourne seafront looking over the Channel. It has 32 en-suite rooms, some with sea views or balconies, a restaurant and bar, and a sea-view lounge. Packed lunches are available, which is handy for days spent on the beach.
surfTripFit: Seafront position on the eastern promenade, with packed lunches and a dog-friendly policy.
